independent_test.dataset: Moussally et al. body-only computer-generated pictures of women
independent_test.label: Valence M: mean of attractiveness, beauty, and harmony ratings on a 1-9 scale
limitations: Body-specific, but the label is not attractiveness-only.
All stimuli are synthetic female bodies on one shape continuum.
This set cannot by itself justify a production-model replacement across sexes, clothing, poses, cameras, or demographics.

diagnostic_validation.role: training-contaminated pipeline and preprocessing diagnostic only

metrics.primary: Spearman rank correlation on all finite independent-test rows
secondary: exact pairwise ordering accuracy at multiple label gaps
metrics.confidence_intervals: 1000 fixed-seed bootstrap repetitions; paired for before/after deltas

candidate_policy.selection_data: No scoring candidate may be selected on the independent test. A candidate must first be fixed on separate development data.
candidate_policy.test_access: Evaluate a fixed candidate once on identical independent-test rows.
candidate_policy.subgroup_and_stability_rule: Reject if a legitimately measured subgroup or registered stability slice worsens materially.
candidate_policy.model_replacement_rule: This independent set is too narrow to authorize replacement by itself; a broader body-specific locked test is required.
candidate_policy.calibration_rule: A monotone percentile/display remap receives no credit for Spearman, AUC, or pairwise ordering because it cannot change rank.

allowed_without_claiming_better_discrimi: async generation ownership and stale-result prevention
model cache/version binding and bounded failure handling
refusing a route that has no surviving score cue
engineering_change_policy.score_behavior_expectation: Common finite rows should remain numerically identical unless a pre-registered scoring candidate wins.
